references.text: Psalm 22 describes the suffering of a righteous person, which many Christians see as a prophecy of Jesus' suffering and death.
Isaiah 53 prophesies about a suffering servant, which Christianity interprets as a prophecy of Jesus' suffering, death, and resurrection.
Here too, a Roman officer acknowledges that Jesus was God's Son after experiencing the earthquake and what happened at his death.
Luke reports a similar acknowledgment from a Roman officer that Jesus truly was righteous.
